Iridescent.description: Covered in shimmering scales that refract light and confuse attackers.

features.name: Iridescent Surki
features.tldr: You can flash your shell to create a momentary distraction against foes.

Burrower.description: Equipped with strong claws and sensory antennae for underground excavation.

features.name: Burrower Surki
